facts.claim: In January, UPS Airlines announced that it would retire its entire fleet of 27 McDonnell Douglas MD-11 widebody cargo jets to be replaced by the newer Boeing 767-300F.
UPS wrote off the entire MD-11 fleet at a loss of nearly $140 million, while FedEx returned its MD-11 examples to service.
The MD-11F carries 26 main deck pallet positions compared with 24 for the 767-300F, and the 767 cargo variant boasts 35% lower fuel consumption than the older trijet.

UPS Flight 2976, an MD-11 freighter bound for Honolulu, crashed after taking off from Louisville on November 4, 2025, killing 15 people, and the NTSB has not published its full and final report on the accident.
Boeing has locked in a deadline of 2027 to close the commercial 767 production line once current orders for UPS and FedEx are filled, with UPS final deliveries scheduled for 2027.

zh.title: UPS以波音767貨機取代27架MD-11機隊
zh.summary: UPS決定讓27架MD-11全數退役，改以較省油的波音767-300F接替；此舉源於2025年路易維爾空難後的機隊檢修與成本考量，聯邦快遞則選擇讓同型機復飛。
body: UPS航空於今年1月宣布，27架麥道MD-11廣體貨機將全數退役，改由較新的波音767-300F接替。報導指出，雖然飛安是首要考量，但最終決定仍基於商業因素：2025年11月UPS2976號班機在路易維爾起飛後墜毀，造成15人罹難，調查發現左翼發動機掛架出現關鍵故障，後續檢測將使機隊長時間停擺，而UPS最終以近1.4億美元損失將整批MD-11除帳，聯邦快遞則選擇讓同型機恢復服務。
載運能力方面，MD-11F主甲板可裝載26個貨盤，767-300F則為24個，差距有限；但767-300F的油耗較老三發動機機型低約35%，且維護計畫較簡化、派飛可靠度較高，更符合以輕量電商包裹為主的現今貨運市場。波音已定於2027年關閉商用767生產線，僅保留軍用衍生型，UPS身為767-300F的首家客戶，如今也將成為最後一批交機客戶之一，最終交機排定於2027年。

en.title: UPS to replace its 27 MD-11s with Boeing 767 freighters
en.summary: UPS will retire its entire fleet of 27 MD-11 widebody freighters and replace them with the more fuel-efficient Boeing 767-300F, a decision shaped by the November 2025 Louisville crash, inspection costs and a nearly $140 million write-off, while FedEx returned its trijets to service.
body: In January, UPS Airlines announced that it would retire its entire fleet of 27 McDonnell Douglas MD-11 widebody cargo jets to be replaced by the newer Boeing 767-300F. Safety of flight was a primary concern, but the final decision was based on business: the investigation of UPS flight 2976 revealed a critical failure of the left-wing engine pylon that would have required extensive non-destructive testing of the remaining jets, and UPS wrote off the entire MD-11 fleet at a loss of nearly $140 million. FedEx, by contrast, returned its examples to service.

On capacity, the MD-11F carries 26 main deck pallet positions compared with 24 for the 767-300F, a small sacrifice for express operators. The 767 cargo variant boasts 35% lower fuel consumption than the older trijet, along with near-perfect mechanical reliability and a streamlined maintenance program. Boeing has locked in a deadline of 2027 to close the commercial 767 production line once current orders for UPS and FedEx are filled, and UPS, the launch customer for the 767-300F, expects its final deliveries in 2027.
